info.title: Report System API
info.description: API documentation for the report system backend. Most school-scoped endpoints require an owner Sanctum token with the `permit:owner` ability.

post.description: Authenticate a client and return a Sanctum token.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated client with their schools.

post.description: Revokes the current Sanctum personal access token.
Emails a password reset link when the client email exists.
Resets the client password using a valid reset token and revokes existing tokens.

put.description: Updates the authenticated student's profile. Requires student ability.
Updates the authenticated teacher's profile. Requires teacher ability.

post.description: Creates an owner client and their school, then returns a Sanctum token.

post.summary: Add subjects to a class menu
Assign a teacher to subjects in a class

get.summary: List students with pending class marks
get.description: Students who take the subject in the class and term but have no class-score contribution, or a contribution of 0. Marks with closeClassScoreEntry true are excluded. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

get.summary: List students with recorded class marks
get.description: Students whose class-score contribution is greater than 0 and closeClassScoreEntry is false.

post.description: Sets closeClassScoreEntry to true for matching marks that are still open. Returns those marks without nested student, subject, class, year, term, or teacher objects. Closed marks are excluded from pending and recorded class-mark lists. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

Enter continuous assessment scores for one or more students. Exam score is stored as 0 until exam marks are submitted. Required class fields depend on the school scoring mode. Returns the created marks without nested student, subject, class, year, term, or teacher objects.

total_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is total_score

division_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is division_score

put.description: Updates continuous assessment scores for a single mark without changing the exam score. Returns the mark without nested student, subject, class, year, term, or teacher objects. Rejects the request when closeClassScoreEntry is true.

total_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is total_score

division_score.summary: Payload when scoring mode is division_score

422.description: Validation error, or class score entry is closed for this mark

get.summary: List students with pending exam marks
get.description: Students who take the subject in the class and term but have no exam score, or an exam score of 0. Marks with closeExamScoreEntry true are excluded. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

get.summary: List students with recorded exam marks
get.description: Students whose exam score is greater than 0 and closeExamScoreEntry is false.

post.description: Sets closeExamScoreEntry to true for matching marks that are still open. Returns those marks without nested student, subject, class, year, term, or teacher objects. Closed marks are excluded from pending and recorded exam-mark lists. Requires schoolClassId, subjectId, and termId.

put.description: Saves exam scores for one or more students. Updates the exam score when a mark already exists for the student, subject, and term. Creates the mark with class scores of 0 if it does not exist. participated is required; examScore is required when participated is true. When participated is false, grade is stored as null. Returns 201 when every item is created, or 200 when any existing mark is updated. Nested student, subject, class, year, term, and teacher objects are not included. Rejects the request when any matching mark has closeExamScoreEntry true.

422.description: Validation error, or exam score entry is closed for one or more marks

get.description: Returns the school scoring setup. Creates default total-score settings if none exist.

put.description: Updates the active scoring mode and both total-score and division-score configurations. divisionTotal and divisionTotalPercent are derived by the backend.

get.summary: List schools for the authenticated owner
get.description: Returns all schools owned by the authenticated client.

post.summary: Create a school for the authenticated owner
post.description: Creates a school owned by the authenticated client and initializes default mark settings. New schools start as active and not in session. motto and email are optional.

put.description: Updates school profile fields for a school owned by the authenticated client. motto is optional. Use the in-session and status endpoints to change those values.
Marks the given school as in session and sets inSession to false for all other schools owned by the same client.
Updates the status of a school owned by the authenticated client.
Updates class name and alias. Use the status endpoint to change status.
Updates the status of a class belonging to a school owned by the authenticated owner.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of students belonging to the authenticated owner's school.

post.description: Creates a student, enrolls them in a class for the school's current academic year, auto-assigns mandatory subjects, and optionally assigns elective subjects.

electiveSubjectIds.description: Optional. Only subjects offered as electives on the class menu can be selected.

get.description: Returns a single student belonging to the authenticated owner's school.

put.description: Updates student personal details for a school owned by the authenticated owner. Does not change class enrollment or subjects.

get.summary: List subjects a student is enrolled in
get.description: Returns active subject enrollments for the student.

post.summary: Enroll a student in a class
post.description: Creates an active enrollment and auto-assigns mandatory class subjects.

get.summary: List student subjects for an enrollment

post.summary: Assign elective subjects to a student enrollment
post.description: Adds elective (non-mandatory) subjects to an active enrollment.

put.description: Updates subject name and code. Use the status endpoint to change status.
Updates the status of a subject belonging to a school owned by the authenticated owner.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of teachers belonging to the authenticated owner's school.

post.description: Creates a teacher client account (role: teacher, status: active) and school teacher record. A password reset link is emailed so the teacher can set their password.

get.description: Returns a single teacher belonging to the authenticated owner's school.

put.description: Updates teacher name and phone for a school owned by the authenticated owner.

get.summary: List subjects taught by a teacher
get.description: Returns distinct subjects the teacher is currently assigned to teach via class subject assignments.

post.description: Sends a password reset link to the teacher's client email address.

classScore.description: Must not exceed classScorePercent on the active mark setting.
Must not exceed classScoreMax on the active mark setting.

homeAssignmentScore.description: Must not exceed homeAssignmentMax on the active mark setting.

projectScore.description: Must not exceed projectMax on the active mark setting.

classTestScore.description: Must not exceed classTestMax on the active mark setting.

examScore.description: Exam score out of 100. Required when participated is true.

MarkWithoutRelations.description: A mark without nested student, subject, class, year, term, teacher, or school objects.

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token. Send as: Bearer {token}
